purpose: Test teacher-score-aware MarginMSE distillation on a small BGE-M3 hybrid MIRACL Arabic teacher-data sample.

eval_sample.sample: 50 queries / 1000 docs positive-plus-negatives sample; not comparable to full MIRACL results.

interpretation: The MarginMSE data path is now implemented and verified: 64 teacher rows expanded to 512 scored triples.
The smoke converged to a low training loss, but the same fixed MIRACL Arabic sample regressed by -0.011906 nDCG@10 versus base BGE-M3.
It also trailed the plain MNR v39 smoke by -0.003383 on the same sample.
This suggests dense-only SentenceTransformer fine-tuning of BGE-M3 is the wrong route for preserving the hybrid dense/sparse/ColBERT teacher behavior.
next_experiment: Stop dense-only BGE-M3 smoke training for now. Move to the official FlagEmbedding BGE-M3 distillation path or train a separate student model that is evaluated as dense-only, rather than trying to improve BGE-M3 hybrid via a SentenceTransformer dense checkpoint.
